name: endurance

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac:local: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.yml -c.mac.identity="${ENDURANCE_SIGNING_IDENTITY:-Endurance Local Signing}" -c.mac.timestamp=none -c.mac.notarize=false -c.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:desktop
scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/smoke-desktop.mjs && node scripts/smoke-model-settings.mjs && node scripts/smoke-workspace.mjs
scripts.test:harness: node --import tsx --test tests/harness.test.ts tests/runtime-discovery.test.ts tests/workspace.test.ts tests/compaction.test.ts tests/history.test.ts tests/vault.test.ts tests/web.test.ts tests/reasoning.test.ts tests/loop-guard.test.ts tests/runtime-styles.test.ts tests/profiles.test.ts tests/thinking-control.test.ts tests/budget.test.ts tests/context-window.test.ts tests/earlier.test.ts tests/request-shape.test.ts tests/skills.test.ts tests/trace.test.ts tests/agent-loop.test.ts tests/shell.test.ts tests/failure.test.ts tests/output.test.ts tests/ollama-chat.test.ts tests/openai-chat-lowering.test.ts tests/continuation.test.ts tests/limit.test.ts tests/documents.test.ts tests/sampling.test.ts tests/model-kinds.test.ts tests/attachments.test.ts tests/connections.test.ts tests/identity.test.ts tests/ordering.test.ts tests/conversation-search.test.ts tests/interrupted.test.ts tests/instructions.test.ts tests/title.test.ts tests/transcribe.test.ts tests/restore.test.ts tests/prompt-recall.test.ts tests/chat-export.test.ts tests/terminal.test.ts tests/permissions.test.ts
scripts.test:model-settings: node --import tsx --test tests/model-settings.test.ts tests/manager-client.test.ts tests/model-huggingface.test.ts tests/model-ollama-library.test.ts tests/model-downloads.test.ts tests/memory-estimate.test.ts
scripts.lint:desktop: eslint electron src/harness src/lib/desktop.ts src/lib/workspace-policy.ts src/lib/workspace-api.ts electron.vite.config.ts

description: Endurance desktop UI and local-model harness
author: stellarsteader
